requirements.contract: Owned immutable live and historical payloads are verified against their digest before retrieval; corruption, unsafe paths and unexplained links fail.
Inclusive 1-based ranges and case-insensitive literal matches preserve matching anchors ahead of context within line and byte limits.
Digest-only preview stays within 1,536 bytes and 12 lines; explicit results stay within 32,768 bytes and 200 lines, with truthful clipping metadata and intact UTF-8.
Writer and reader agree on archive roots; backing Bash files require matching real truncation metadata and cannot replace unrelated inline results.
Archives survive shutdown, deduplicate, recover known interrupted publication and remain untouched by cancellation or retrieval; rehydrated output is not recursively condensed.
Actual Pi registration, activation, model tool calls, schema validation and persistence work on the pinned SDK without network inference.
